summary: Interpreted the new receipt, which turns the store-failure lead into a witnessed account: in the injected case (receipt bd46b877825a4476b23bcc394778c324, indices 1-2) the conflicting append left the follower with in-memory last index 3 while its store held only index 1, answered the leader with Success false and LastLog 3, and then rejected a whole-log re-append as well, with the store still at index 1; the control case (indices 4-5) accepted both appends and ended with the store at index 3, so the failure is the cause and not the request sequence. Rewrote the question's account with the experiment id and all six event indices, conclusion explained and defect_claim asserted, added a Fact recording the measured divergence and rejection with its execution indices, cited the existing behavior entry as a knowledge use, and re-pointed the discriminator at what the receipt does not cover: a live leader producing the retry sequence and the stale index as used in the follower's own vote responses. Validation returned valid with those effects and no execution requested; remaining limits are the single request shape per case, the supplied store fault, and the disputed fatal-error reading.
